content: ESP32 ROM CRC32 available in Arduino sketches via #include <esp_rom_crc.h>: esp_rom_crc32_le(init, data, len) - reflected polynomial (zlib/Ethernet-style CRC32), hardware ROM tables, works on ESP32-S3. Pass 0 as init for first block; chain for non-contiguous buffers. Both Cosmic1 firmwares can use the identical function so end-to-end convention consistency is guaranteed.
